# Every task. Every calendar. One app.

Everything you have to do and everywhere you have to be, in one calm place.  
 Connect the calendar you already use and your week is simply there - then capture the rest in a sentence, with an AI that runs on your device, not in the cloud.

Download on the App Store Get it on Google Play

Or use it in your browser →

Most task apps start empty and ask you to rebuild your life inside them. This one starts with the life you already have - on iPhone, iPad, Android and the web.

Work Life Panda on tablet and phone: a weekly calendar with an event imported from email beside the phone's task list for today

Tasks, events, calendar, notes & a chat on each - one calm place. [...] Personal & family

### A calmer home base for your life - and everyone you share it with

Chores, kids, plans, reminders, notes, and birthdays - captured in a sentence and kept in one private place, on every device you already own. No shared wall tablet required.  Teams & business

### Keep group plans moving without drowning in noisy chat

Trips, clubs, shared houses, side projects, and small teams - give the plan a real home where tasks, events, files, and the conversation about them live together, not scattered across a chat thread and three tools.

Safe local AI

### Keep control while safe local AI automates the busy steps

Panda AI smooths the busy parts - capture a thought, turn it into structure, and move faster, without handing your life to an opaque cloud. [...] ### From your inbox to your calendar

A booking lands in your inbox; the event lands on your calendar. Connect an iCloud or Outlook mailbox and the invitations already sitting in it become events on their own - no forwarding, no copying. Gmail is waiting on Google’s security review.

Questions

results.content:
Underneath it's a real task manager, and the AI that turns a sentence or your voice into a task runs on your device. Small local models, no cloud round-trip for the everyday stuff. "Private by default" isn't a tagline here.  
  
And then the bit nobody expects: every task and event carries its own chat, files and history. Share one into a private Family, Group or Work space and the conversation about a thing lives on the thing, instead of scrolling away in a group chat.  
  
It's early access and completely free while I build. No ads, no purchases yet. I'd genuinely love brutal feedback: what clicks, what's missing, and, if you'd ever pay for something like this, what would make it worth it. I'm in the comments all day. 🐼

### Top forum threads [...] 👋 Hey Product Hunt, I'm Andrea, the maker behind Work Life Panda.  
  
My week lived in a calendar, my to-dos in a list, and every plan involving another person in a group chat: three apps, none of which talked to each other. So I built the merge: a real task manager and a real calendar that are the same thing.  
  
And it starts full. Sign in with one tap, connect the calendar you already use (Google, Apple, Outlook or others) and your actual week is just there: still your calendar, not a copy, so a change in either place is a change in both. Connect a mailbox and the invitations already sitting in it quietly become events. Nothing to import, nothing to retype.
